input_unit: opaque sentinel aggregate after initial outputs freeze
candidate_trigger: Uniform escalation if any failure fraction exceeds failure_fraction_limit OR conservative contrast halfwidth exceeds target_halfwidth. Missing, invalid or incomplete inputs HALT.
failure_fraction: failed_or_indeterminate_count / scheduled_count; all planned attempts stay in the denominator
precision_bound: For an independent replicate contrast bounded in [-1,1], conservative normal-approximation halfwidth = critical_value / sqrt(scheduled_count). This is a planning bound, not an exact confidence guarantee or scientific acceptance test.
alternative_for_decision: A bounded-variable concentration bound may be selected instead; its confidence level and exact formula must be prespecified. Do not mix conventions after inspection.
resource_candidate: By prespecified stage, use maximum observed resource cost per attempted dataset, multiply by planned attempts and an approved safety multiplier; divide elapsed workload by approved effective concurrency. Missing measures HALT; failures remain in workload accounting.

proposed_optional_release_fields.conservative_contrast_halfwidth: finite nonnegative number; only if approved
proposed_optional_release_fields.projected_core_hours: finite nonnegative number; only if approved

forbidden_release: Per-condition truth-keyed recovery results, geometry effect direction/magnitude, labels or mappings
decision_questions: Is the proposed trigger appropriate for operational pilot escalation?
Which precision convention, constants and missing/failure handling are approved?
Which exact resource/precision fields and types may be released?
